result.title: CoGenRec: A Unified Generative Framework for Complementary Vision Reconstruction
result.summary: Capturing scenes with extreme motion and high dynamic range is fundamentally constrained by trade-offs among temporal resolution, spatial detail, signal-to-noise ratio, and dynamic range under practical bandwidth, power, and quantum-efficiency limits. Conventional frame-based cameras therefore suffer from temporal undersampling, exposure-induced motion blur, and sensor saturation. The Complementary Vision Sensor (CVS) addresses these limitations by decomposing visual information across two complementary pathways, a spatially dense, temporally sparse, long-exposure RGB pathway and a temporally dense, spatially sparse, short-exposure patiotemporal difference pathway. Their complementary measurements provide appearance, structural, and motion cues across a wide dynamic range that enable reconstruction beyond conventional imaging. We present CoGenRec, a complementarity-driven generative reconstruction framework that unifies video deblurring, high-temporal-resolution frame interpolation, and HDR fusion. CoGenRec encodes complementary measurements into multi-scale spatiotemporal features using exposure-aware appearance modeling and bidirectional temporal propagation. These features constrain a video diffusion model and are injected into the VAE decoder to recover fine structures lost during latent-space compression, combining the scene fidelity of physical measurements with the appearance recovery capabilities of learned video priors. On SportsSloMo-CVS, CoGenRec improves PSNR over the strongest general-purpose baseline by 4.40 dB for deblurring, 3.89 dB for frame interpolation, and 5.04 dB for HDR fusion, respectively. It also achieves strong perceptual quality on 129 unseen scenes captured with real CVS. These results establish a unified approach to advance high-quality reconstruction under challenging motion and illumination conditions. Project page: https://cogenrec.github.io/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CoGenRec，一个面向互补视觉传感器（长曝光 RGB 通路与短曝光时空差分通路）的统一生成式重建框架：用曝光感知外观建模与双向时序传播编码多尺度时空特征，条件化视频扩散模型并注入 VAE 解码器，统一处理去模糊、高帧率插值与 HDR 融合。
AI.relevance_reason: 原文指出 latent 空间压缩会丢失细结构，并借助物理测量特征向 VAE 解码器侧注入来补偿；这一「压缩导致视觉细节流失、需外部证据回填」的现象，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节是否保留在内部状态及信息坍缩评估提供可核查线索，但论文不涉及推理生成与停止决策。
